fields.title: 5. Probability and Value — No Change
fields.md:
- Probability adjustment rules R1–R6 not met — scenarios 25/50/25 maintained (rules in the [2026-11 report](2026-11.md)).
- Assumed value band $265.0–$684.5 · probability-weighted $469.6 · base $464.4 — same as the first issue (formulas and sources in the valuation section of the [2026-11 report](2026-11.md)).
- Price update (close, [stockanalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/brk.b/history/)): 2026-11-18 $574.62 (−2.1% from the previous day, formula 574.62 ÷ 586.76 − 1) · 2026-11-19 **$572.04** (−0.4%). 3.5% below the record closing high of $592.94 (2026-11-13) (formula 572.04 ÷ 592.94 − 1).
- 23.2% above the base present value (formula 572.04 ÷ 464.4 − 1, previously 26.3%). With the exit P/B fixed at 1.45x, the implied BPS compounding is 10.3% (formula (572.04 × 2.411 ÷ (357.73 × 1.45))^(1/10) − 1, previously 10.6% — Class B BPS $357.73 is equity ÷ Class A-equivalent share count from the [10-Q](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526452412/brka-20260930.htm), formula).
- Market cap about $1,217.5 billion (formula 572.04 × 1,418,900 × 1,500) − net cash $356.9 billion − equities $335.5 billion = value assigned to operating businesses of about $525.0 billion → 13.8x annualized after-tax operating earnings excluding investment income of $38.08 billion (formula 525,040 ÷ 38,080, same approximation as the first issue). The net borrowing increase of $540 million (estimate) does not change the definition of net cash (cash-side definition — state.definitions.cash), so it is not included in this formula. Net cash and equity fair value are from the [10-Q](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526452412/brka-20260930.htm) (2026-09-30).
- This probe does not judge the cause of the two-day −2.5% (formula 572.04 ÷ 586.76 − 1) — it merely coincides in date with the note settlement disclosure, with no causal basis (judgment, closing prices from [stockanalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/brk.b/history/)).
